result.reason: The redline fully reaches the preferred position by removing the sole-supplier obligation and expressly allowing Customer to use third-party providers. It preserves the underlying intent that Vendor provide hosted analytics services and is consistent with Section 12.3. However, the added minimum-volume and third-party-services language is not strictly necessary and duplicates protections already stated in Section 12.3, so the change is broader than the minimum required. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
